description: This file defines a public enum 'NetworkInterfaceIPv4' with a nested struct 'AddressEntry' and a static method 'addresses' that retrieves IPv4 network interface addresses on the current device.

classes.name: AddressEntry
classes.description: A structure representing a network interface address with a name and IP address.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IPv4 addresses associated with active network interfaces that are up and not loopback.
